claim: The sample has three realistic responses and never changes the real workspace.
sandbox: create real data through the UI; enter, edit, reset, and leave the separate demo

claim: Imports plain-text response files up to 1 MB.
sandbox: upload a valid fixture, then a generated 1,000,001-byte boundary fixture

claim: The teacher chooses a criterion, edits a comment block, and adds a personal next step before marking feedback ready.
sandbox: sample response with blank feedback; exercise validation, editing, keyboard save, and queue advancement

claim: Copies complete feedback with the personal next step.
sandbox: sample response; read the browser clipboard and compare teacher feedback and next step

claim: Exports one CSV row per response.
sandbox: three-response demo; inspect the downloaded CSV header and all records

claim: Downloads the complete local workspace as JSON.
sandbox: three-response demo; parse the download and check responses and the custom comment

claim: Keeps queue edits in browser storage after reload.
sandbox: fresh real workspace; import and edit through the UI, then reload

claim: Works offline after the first visit.
sandbox: dedicated fresh browser context; load demo, wait for its service worker, go offline, and reload

claim: Student writing stays in the browser during the free review workflow.
where: first screen, limits, privacy page, README
sandbox: record all demo requests and bodies; require same-origin traffic, no writing, and no cookies

claim: The app does not score, rewrite, detect plagiarism, generate feedback, or create student profiles.
where: limits, privacy page, terms page, README
sandbox: import an original response; verify teacher fields remain blank, no result appears, and storage contains only the stated workspace fields

claim: Core review, copy, CSV export, and local backup need no account or payment.
sandbox: complete and export the sample without authentication, checkout, or external requests

claim: The service counts aggregate page views without analytics scripts, tracking cookies, or third-party fonts.
sandbox: fresh page; record scripts, page-view POSTs, and browser cookies

claim: A confirmed delete removes one response and a cancelled delete changes nothing.
sandbox: three-response demo; dismiss once, accept once, and compare the queue

claim: The health endpoint reports service status and build identity.
sandbox: release-style local server; inspect the health JSON response

claim: API request limits use the forwarded client address and return Retry-After with HTTP 429.
sandbox: burst one forwarded client until 429, inspect Retry-After, then verify a second client keeps its allowance

claim: When the /data mount exists, SQLite uses it and stored counts survive a process restart.
sandbox: temporary mounted-data directory; assert the selected database path, insert a count, close the pool, reopen it, and read the count

claim: Existing licensed backups are encrypted in the browser before upload.
sandbox: cached license fixture; save a workspace with unique private text, intercept the upload, and inspect its encrypted envelope

claim: An existing license can save, restore, and delete its encrypted backup without changing local work during deletion.
sandbox: cached license and recorded server-response fixture; save, modify, restore, delete, and inspect the local workspace

claim: The correct passphrase restores an encrypted backup and a different passphrase cannot open it.
sandbox: encrypt a sample workspace, restore with the correct phrase, and reject a different phrase
